description: Highly contagious viral disease of cloven-hoofed animals causing fever, vesicles on the mouth and feet, and severe production loss. Outbreaks spread rapidly through direct contact, contaminated feed, and movement of animals and people between farms.
symptoms: blisters on hooves and between digits
critical_symptoms: blisters on hooves and between digits
first_aid: Isolate the affected animal immediately from the rest of the herd.
Stop all movement of animals, vehicles, and people off the farm until a veterinarian confirms the situation.
Provide soft, palatable feed and clean water; avoid forcing the animal to walk on painful hooves.
Disinfect footwear, tools, and troughs that contacted saliva or blister fluid.
Notify the nearest government veterinary officer or livestock department without delay.
